Adjacent paragraphs in a layout-table cell are separated rather than concatenated into one run of text

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<table><tr><td><p><b>Alice Example</b></p><p><i>Customer Service</i></p></td><td>Logo</td></tr><tr><td>A</td><td>B</td><td>C</td></tr></table>", new ConversionOptions { CompactTables = true });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
